summary: 70-foot Aermotor observation tower in Big Hill Pond State Park, McNairy County, TN; build date unknown, listed as surviving in 2014, and open to climb by park visitors.

access.note: Inside Big Hill Pond State Park; described as climbable by Tennessee Magazine and the Tennessee Hiking Club

visit.trail_note: Reached along the Turkey Call and Tuscumbia trails in the park; Tennessee Hiking Club lists a route of 4.3 miles

events.note: Listed as extant in the National Register study of Tennessee Division of Forestry fire towers, as of March 26, 2014
Registered December 30, 2022 as US 1710, TN 43; nominated by Jason Johns

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register lists Tennessee State Parks as administrator (2022). The 2014 National Register study lists the tower among Division of Forestry fire towers but does not name an owner. The story uses the Register's current administrator and does not claim a transfer date.

notes_for_editor: Build date and original owner are unknown; the Register and the 2014 study give no build date. Do not confuse this with the Big Hill Fire Lookout Tower in Marion County, a separate tower listed on the National Register in 2021. The Tennessee State Parks page returned 403 and was not used. Access rests on Tennessee Magazine and the Tennessee Hiking Club; confirm with the park before publishing. No photos added.
